decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i0: exact NL3 endpoint contract, source transitions tr_0001 and tr_0002, precise closed-model binding, complete transition inventory, and S2 receipt.
decisions.reason: The NL3 clause requires the system to enter HumanDriving on Power_On. The exact binding identifies the required source as the closed-model system owner and the target as HumanDriving. The complete model inventory instead contains an initial edge to HumanDriving and a Power_On transition from HumanDriving to Autonomous, with no system-to-HumanDriving transition. The possible enclosing-machine reading of system is expressly not resolved by any supplied equivalence, so it is not a competent surviving alternative.
decisions.violated_obligation: A Power_On transition must connect the required system source to HumanDriving.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i1: exact NL4 endpoint contract, precise source and target bindings, source transition tr_0007, closed-model transition line 19, and the supplied unsupported-predicate receipt.
decisions.reason: The NL4 clause requires a transition from system to Autonomous under the front-distance condition. The exact model facts show the corresponding transition from HumanDriving to Autonomous on Front_Distance_10_2, and no transition with source system and target Autonomous. The lack of an executable predicate does not alter the precise semantic comparison. The supplied enclosing-machine shorthand is not supported by an equivalence mapping, so it does not survive.
decisions.violated_obligation: A front-distance condition must produce a transition from the required system source to Autonomous.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i2: exact NL4.2 endpoint contract, source transition tr_0005, precise bindings for AutonomousFinal and HumanDriving, closed transition line 17, and S2 receipt.
decisions.reason: The NL4.2 clause requires a transition to HumanDriving from the system in the Auto Final context, triggered by Human_Steering_Cmd with the stated brake and final-state condition. The exact carrier is AutonomousActive to HumanDriving on Human_Steering_Cmd with no guard, and no system-sourced transition with the required combined condition exists. A separate brake-triggered transition and the shared target do not supply the missing scoped relation. The enclosing-scope interpretation is not backed by a supplied equivalence.
decisions.violated_obligation: The required Auto Final, trigger, brake, and target relation must be represented by a transition to HumanDriving.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i3: exact NL5 endpoint contract, precise AutonomousFinal binding, source transition tr_0008, closed-model transition line 20, and the supplied unsupported-predicate receipt.
decisions.reason: The NL5 clause requires Power_Off to transition from the required system source to AutonomousFinal. The exact model inventory shows Power_Off from HumanDriving to AutonomousFinal and no transition with source system. AutonomousFinal is the correct target, but that does not rebut the source mismatch. No supplied mapping equates system with HumanDriving.
decisions.violated_obligation: A Power_Off transition must connect the required system source to AutonomousFinal.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i4: NL5 termination contract, exact AutonomousFinal and Power_Off bindings, reachability and zero-outgoing facts, and the supplied unsupported-predicate receipt.
decisions.reason: The NL5 clause requires completion after Power_Off reaches the designated final state. AutonomousFinal is exactly bound and reachable, but the supplied deterministic facts describe it as a reachable leaf with zero outgoing transitions and do not provide an explicit completion marker. The possibility that a zero-outgoing state is terminal is not supported by an exact terminal fact in this dossier, so it is not a surviving rebuttal.
decisions.violated_obligation: After Power_Off reaches AutonomousFinal, the state must be established as a completed terminal state.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i5: exact NL3 Power_On contract, source transition tr_0002, precise event/state/transition bindings, complete inventory, and S2 receipt.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i6: exact NL4 contract, source mappings tr_0004 and tr_0007, precise event/state/transition bindings, closed-model endpoint inventory, and unsupported-predicate receipt.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i7: exact NL4.2 scoped endpoint contract, source transitions tr_0005 and tr_0006, precise trigger/context bindings, complete closed inventory, and S2 receipt.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i8: NL5 termination contract, exact Power_Off edge to AutonomousFinal, reachability and zero-outgoing facts, and the supplied unsupported-predicate receipt.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i9: exact V4 binding for AutonomousFinal, NL5 source clause, finite reachability and outgoing-transition facts, source certificate, and completed FBMCQ receipt.

issues.expected: A Power_On transition from the required system source to HumanDriving.
issues.observed: The closed model has an initial edge to HumanDriving and a Power_On edge from HumanDriving to Autonomous; no transition has source system and target HumanDriving.
issues.reason: The required source system is not represented as an exact closed-model transition source. The closed model instead has an initial edge to HumanDriving and a Power_On edge from HumanDriving to Autonomous; therefore the required system-to-HumanDriving relation is not established.
issues.requirement_quote: when power on, the system turn into human driving mode
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The phrase system might be intended as an enclosing machine rather than a literal transition source, but the supplied contract explicitly types system as source and provides no equivalence that resolves that interpretation.
issues.title: Power-on transition has the wrong closed-model relation

issues.basis: NL4 contract; exact source inventory transition tr_0007; FCSTM transition line 19; no exact system-to-Autonomous transition exists.
issues.expected: A transition from system to Autonomous under front_distance > 10.
issues.observed: The closed model has HumanDriving to Autonomous on Front_Distance_10_2; no transition has source system and target Autonomous.
issues.reason: The target Autonomous is exact, but the required source system is not an exact closed-model transition source. The corresponding closed transition originates at HumanDriving.
issues.requirement_quote: when front_distance > 10, auto transport to autonomous state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: System could be an enclosing-machine shorthand, but no supplied source or mapping fact equates that shorthand with HumanDriving for this transition.
issues.title: Front-distance transition has the wrong closed-model relation

issues.basis: NL4.2 contract; exact source inventory transition tr_0005; FCSTM transition line 17 from AutonomousActive to HumanDriving with Human_Steering_Cmd and null guard; no system-sourced carrier has the stated condition.
issues.expected: A transition from system to HumanDriving triggered by Human_Steering_Cmd with the stated brake and Auto Final condition.
issues.observed: Transition:line:17 goes from AutonomousActive to HumanDriving on Human_Steering_Cmd with no guard; no transition from system is present.
issues.reason: The target HumanDriving and Human_Steering_Cmd consumer are exact, but the required source system is not represented as an exact closed-model source and the closed carrier has no guard. The supplied combined relation is therefore not established.
issues.requirement_quote: transit to human driving mode when receive human steering cmd, brake pressed, in (auto final)
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source phrase system may be an informal enclosing-scope reference, and a separate Brake_Pressed transition reaches the same target, but neither fact supplies the required combined relation.
issues.title: Human-steering transition does not establish the required relation

issues.basis: NL5 contract; exact source inventory transition tr_0008; FCSTM transition line 20; no transition has source system.
issues.expected: A Power_Off transition from system to AutonomousFinal.
issues.observed: The closed model has HumanDriving to AutonomousFinal on Power_Off; no transition has source system.
issues.reason: AutonomousFinal is the exact final-state target, but the required source system is not represented as an exact closed-model source. The Power_Off transition originates at HumanDriving.
issues.requirement_quote: when power off, it will transit to final state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: System may be intended as a non-literal machine-level actor, but the contract's typed source hint does not define that equivalence and the closed model exposes HumanDriving as the exact carrier source.
issues.title: Power-off transition has a different closed-model source

issues.basis: NL5 termination contract; state:AutonomousFinal:line:12; LEAF_WITHOUT_OUTGOING diagnostic; deadlock verification check for AutonomousFinal.
issues.expected: After Power_Off reaches the designated final state, the system terminates there as a completed state.
issues.observed: AutonomousFinal is reachable and has zero outgoing FCSTM transitions; the finite verification summary records the corresponding non-proved deadlock check.
issues.reason: The final state binds exactly to reachable AutonomousFinal, but deterministic inspection reports that it has no outgoing transition. The finite verification summary records a dead-end leaf at this exact state, so stable completion is not established by the supplied facts.
issues.requirement_quote: when power off, it will transit to final state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: A zero-outgoing state can represent a terminal state in some formalisms, but the supplied deterministic facts classify it as a reachable leaf without an explicit completion marker.
issues.title: Final state is not stably completed

issues.basis: NL3 requires power-on entry into human driving mode. The source transition tr_0002 is the corresponding authored Power On relation, and the closed model binds it to HumanDriving -> Autonomous with Power_On.
issues.expected: On the power-on transition, the system enters human driving mode.
issues.observed: The closed model has a Power_On transition from HumanDriving to Autonomous (transition:line:14); no complete-inventory transition with the required system-to-human-driving endpoint is present.
issues.reason: The exact Power On consumer is bound to transition:line:14, but its target is Autonomous rather than the required HumanDriving state. The endpoint comparison therefore identifies a wrong target while preserving the transition contract.
issues.requirement_quote: when power on, the system turn into human driving mode
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source and closed model both contain a Power On transition, but the supplied closed endpoint is Autonomous, so event presence does not rebut the required target mismatch.
issues.title: Power-on enters the wrong state

issues.basis: NL4 names system as source and autonomous state as target under front_distance > 10. The source inventory maps this condition to tr_0004 and tr_0007, while the closed inventory binds the corresponding event to transition:line:16 and transition:line:19 with different endpoint pairs.
issues.expected: When front_distance > 10, the system transitions to autonomous state.
issues.observed: The closed model's Front_Distance_10_2 transition from AutonomousIdle goes to AutonomousActive (transition:line:16), and its other consumer from HumanDriving goes to Autonomous (transition:line:19); neither is an exact system-to-autonomous-state endpoint as stated by the contract.
issues.reason: The required event-condition relation is represented by the source as a transition to the autonomous state, but the closed model distributes the corresponding event across concrete transitions with different sources and targets. The exact endpoint requirement is therefore not realized.
issues.requirement_quote: when front_distance > 10, auto transport to autonomous state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The closed model includes a Front_Distance_10_2 consumer reaching Autonomous from HumanDriving, but that still does not match the contract's exact system-to-autonomous-state endpoint and does not cover the source transition from the autonomous context.
issues.title: Distance condition reaches the wrong state

issues.basis: NL4.2 explicitly requires human steering and brake behavior in auto final. The source inventory identifies tr_0005 and tr_0006 from AutonomousActive to HumanDriving, and the closed transition inventory confirms those exact carriers without an Auto Final source.
issues.expected: Upon the stated human steering command and brake condition in auto final, the system transitions to human driving mode.
issues.observed: The closed model has Human_Steering_Cmd and Brake_Pressed transitions from AutonomousActive to HumanDriving (transition:line:17 and transition:line:18), but no transition from the required Auto Final context is present in the complete inventory.
issues.reason: The closed model provides both named response triggers, but they are carried by transitions from AutonomousActive rather than from the supplied auto-final context. The required context-sensitive endpoint relation is therefore not realized.
issues.requirement_quote: transit to human driving mode when receive human steering cmd, brake pressed, in (auto final)
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Both required trigger names and the HumanDriving target are present, but the supplied source/context requirement includes Auto Final and the closed carriers originate in AutonomousActive, so trigger presence alone cannot discharge the scoped endpoint obligation.
issues.title: Auto-final response is not realized

issues.basis: The source labels AutonomousFinal as the final state; the closed model binds Power_Off to AutonomousFinal, and deterministic reachability/dead-end facts show the target is reachable and has zero outgoing transitions.
issues.expected: After power off reaches final state, the system completes there without continued behavior.
issues.observed: Power_Off reaches AutonomousFinal (transition:line:20), and AutonomousFinal is reachable with no outgoing transition (state:AutonomousFinal:line:12). The supplied facts do not establish a continuation, re-entry, or route out of the target; the no-outgoing fact is consistent with stable completion.
issues.reason: The termination contract is exact and was audited through the target and its available continuation. The power-off edge reaches the intended final-state identity, and the target has no outgoing transition. Because no supplied fact shows re-entry or continued behavior, there is no supported termination violation to emit.
issues.requirement_quote: when power off, it will transit to final state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The diagnostic labels the final leaf as a deadlock frontier, but the supplied NL explicitly defines it as a final state, so zero outgoing transitions are compatible with completion and do not independently prove failed termination.
issues.title: Final state is a stable terminal target

The exact binding identifies the required source as the closed-model system owner and the target as HumanDriving. The complete model inventory instead contains an initial edge to HumanDriving and a Power_On transition from HumanDriving to Autonomous, with no system-to-HumanDriving transition. The lack of an executable predicate does not alter the precise semantic comparison. The supplied enclosing-machine shorthand is not supported by an equivalence mapping, so it does not survive.

The exact carrier is AutonomousActive to HumanDriving on Human_Steering_Cmd with no guard, and no system-sourced transition with the required combined condition exists.
